description: Liste API Ecovélo pour stations vélYcéo électriques sur Saint-Nazaire Agglo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Saint-Nazaire agglo - La CARENE. List of APIs provided by Ecovélo for self-service electric velYcéo on Saint-Nazaire Agglo. Location and availability of self-service electric bikes on Saint-Nazaire Agglomeration - la CARENE (Pornichet, Saint-Malo-de-Guersac, Saint-Nazaire). Coverage: Saint-Nazaire agglo - La CARENE. The portal shows the English title as "List API Ecovélo for electric velYceo stations on Saint-Nazaire Agglo" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Saint-Nazaire agglo - La CARENE. Its keywords include velo, velyceo, station, culture-tourisme, stran, mobilite. The listing shows 3 download or service links in OCTET-STREAM, CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2024-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
